requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and data encryption to protect attendance data.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access based on user roles.
The system shall ensure real-time data synchronization and processing for accurate attendance records.
The system shall implement logging for all attendance modifications and access to ensure accountability.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during operations.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel when necessary.
